subject: Bridge capacity approval request — temporary P1 response exception (Nebula Analytics)
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@nebulaanalytics.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary P1 response exclusion during maintenance (Jun 12-14)

Hi Priyom,

We're scheduling an infrastructure maintenance across our ingestion pipeline from Jun 12 00:00 UTC to Jun 14 04:00 UTC. During that window we'll be running stateful schema migrations and routing changes that will produce a higher-than-normal error rate for our Redwood-backed features.

Because those errors originate in our systems and will be transitory, our SRE lead is asking whether Redwood can temporarily relax the P1 support response SLA so we don't trigger automatic credits and don't escalate on transient alerts during the maintenance window. We want to avoid unnecessary on-call interruptions while we exercise our rollback plan.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve a temporary exception (covering 2026-06-12T00:00Z through 2026-06-14T04:00Z) with the following conditions:
- Mutual action plan (MAP) agreed and shared in advance
- Nebula to open a consolidated incident ticket and keep the bridge open for the window
- Redwood to stand up a "bridge capacity" (additional monitoring/observer) with 1 senior on-call available overnight UTC hours

Attached is our maintenance schedule and the primary contact list. Please let me know the approvals required and any alternative mitigations Redwood recommends.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of SRE, Nebula Analytics
(elena@nebulaanalytics.com)

Attachments: nebula-maintenance-window-20260612-14_UTC.pdf

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena@nebulaanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary P1 response exclusion during maintenance (Jun 12-14)

Elena —

Thanks for the heads-up and the detailed schedule. I can start the internal approval loop today. To move quickly, can you confirm:
1) Will Nebula accept a conditional exception (no automatic credits) provided Redwood is on the shared bridge and has an agreed MAP?
2) Are there any expected changes to request volume or peak token rates beyond the attached schedule?

Tentative plan from our side: we can offer a temporary exception that suspends automatic SLA crediting for the specific incident window if Nebula agrees to the MAP + consolidated incident ticket. We will also propose a lightweight "bridge capacity" plan (one senior on-call for overnight UTC, and optional second engineer during high-risk migrations). That needs approval from my manager and the on-call rota owner.

I'm looping in Karthis (karthik_iyer@redwood.com) and Ben (ben_carter@redwood.com) to confirm operational capacity and any prerequisites. I'll follow up with a proposed document and the runbook we would need.

—Priyom
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Karthik, Ben —

Forwarding Nebula's request (attached). TL;DR: They want a temporary suspension of automatic P1 crediting for one maintenance window (2026-06-12 00:00Z — 2026-06-14 04:00Z) on condition we: share a MAP, join their bridge, and have a senior on-call available overnight UTC.

Questions for ops/coverage: can we commit to the following from Redwood?
- Senior on-call agent (senior SRE/SE) available 00:00–08:00 UTC on both nights (two people total, night 1 + night 2)
- An activation playbook (runbook-p1-bridge-activation.md) that we can trigger if noise crosses threshold
- Suspend automatic crediting only for incidents tagged with NEB-4721 maintenance flag

Ben — do we have headroom in the dedicated rota? Karthik — are there contractual constraints here (SLA language, credits clause) that block conditional suspension?

If we can do this with the runbook and a one-time exec approval, I will confirm with Elena and send the MAP template and the proposed bridge capacity spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Priyom —

We can resource a senior SE for the overnight shifts both nights, subject to:
1) Ben confirms that assigning the senior on-call doesn't create gaps for other P1 customers during that window (we'll treat as temporary augmentation).
2) Legal signs off on the narrow exception wording (credits suspension must be scoped to maintenance-tagged incidents only).

Ben — please check the rota and confirm if we need to pull someone from the standby pool. If so we'll document the extra on-call hours and flag for post-window compensation/credits for the engineer.

I suggest we also require Nebula to:
- Use a single consolidated incident (no multiple separate tickets)
- Provide a run-of-play in Drive by EOD Wed (2026-06-10) so we can validate triggers

If we get all that, I can sign off and route to legal for the exception amendment.

—Karthik

I checked the rota. We have one senior engineer (Olga) in the standby pool who can be assigned both nights; that creates a marginal coverage risk but we can mitigate by elevating one tertiary responder for low-priority pages. I'm OK with the augmentation provided we:
- Log the extra hours (standby compensation)
- Limit the exception strictly to the maintenance-tagged incident(s) and the exact window provided
- Require Nebula to provide the MAP + runbook no later than 2026-06-10 17:00 UTC

I'll prep the runbook skeleton (runbook-p1-bridge-activation.md) and the proposed-bridge-capacity-plan.xlsx and share in Drive. Once Legal confirms wording, we can approve and I will schedule Olga.

—Ben

Elena / Alex —

Thanks for the quick response and for sharing the schedule. Short update and conditional approvals from our side:

1) Operational commitment: Redwood will assign a senior engineer (Olga) on standby for both nights (2026-06-12 and 2026-06-13, 00:00–08:00 UTC) and a tertiary responder for low-priority pages. Ben will share the bridge-capacity spreadsheet and the activation runbook by EOD.

2) Exception scope: Legal needs to sign a narrow amendment that suspends automatic SLA crediting only for incidents explicitly tagged with the NEB-4721 maintenance flag and within the window 2026-06-12T00:00Z — 2026-06-14T04:00Z. This is a one-time exception only.

3) Preconditions from Nebula: consolidated incident ticket, MAP in Drive, and a one-page run-of-play by 2026-06-10 17:00 UTC.

If you confirm acceptance of the conditions above I will route to Legal for the amendment and Ben will publish the operational artifacts and schedule Olga.

Appreciate the coordination — this should let us avoid unnecessary on-call escalations while preserving protections for other customers.

Best,
Priyom
